keywords: pythagoras pythagorean theorem hypotenuse right triangle triangles right-angled
facts: In a right triangle, a² + b² = c², where c is the hypotenuse.
The hypotenuse is the longest side, opposite the right angle.
To find a short side: b² = c² − a².
If a² + b² = c² holds, the triangle has a right angle.

scenes.heading: The Pythagorean theorem
scenes.subtitle: The sides of a right triangle

narration.text: In a right triangle, the three sides are linked by one simple rule.

scenes.heading: Step 1: Name the sides
items: a and b: the two shorter sides
c: hypotenuse, opposite the right angle

narration.text: The two sides that meet at the right angle are called a and b.
The longest side, opposite the right angle, is the hypotenuse, c.
The rule: a squared plus b squared equals c squared.
Three squared is nine, four squared is sixteen, and they add to twenty-five.
The square root of twenty-five is five, so c is five.
To find a shorter side, subtract instead: b squared equals c squared minus a squared.
One hundred sixty-nine minus twenty-five is one hundred forty-four.
The square root of one hundred forty-four is twelve.

scenes.heading: Step 4: Test for a right angle
scenes.problem: Sides 7, 24 and 25. Is it a right triangle?
scenes.answer: Yes, it has a right angle

narration.text: The theorem also works backwards, as a test.
Seven squared plus twenty-four squared is six hundred twenty-five.
Twenty-five squared is also six hundred twenty-five, so the angle is a right angle.

scenes.heading: Step 9: Is it a right triangle?
scenes.problem: A triangle has sides 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm. Is it right-angled?
scenes.answer: Yes, it is a right triangle

narration.text: We can use the theorem backwards to test a triangle.
Six squared plus eight squared is one hundred.
Ten squared is also one hundred.
They match, so the angle between the short sides is a right angle.

scenes.heading: Quick check
scenes.question: a = 6 and b = 8. What is c?

narration.text: Quick check. Six and eight are the short sides. What is c?
Ten: thirty-six plus sixty-four is one hundred, and its root is ten.

scenes.heading: Quick check
scenes.question: c = 10 and a = 6. What is b?

narration.text: Quick check. The hypotenuse is ten and one side is six.
Eight: one hundred minus thirty-six is sixty-four.

scenes.heading: Quick check
scenes.question: Which set of sides makes a right triangle?

narration.text: Quick check. Which set makes a right triangle?
Five, twelve and thirteen: twenty-five plus one hundred forty-four is one hundred sixty-nine.
